evals.prompt: A review finding on PR #5549 says: non-empty accessList is blanket-rejected at opstack-executor/OpstackExecutor.h:479-485 (reviewed head 13cfac80). Verify whether it still holds at the PR's current head. (Both heads exist in this clone; note that the reviewed head is a pre-rebase head carried by a local backup branch, so lineage cannot be assumed.)
evals.expected_output: The verifier re-locates the check by symbol at the pin instead of trusting the cited line numbers, and reports stale with the repair commit plus pre-fix citation.
expectations: Evidence is read with `git show $PIN:<path>`, not from the reviewer's line numbers or the working tree
The cited line range is re-resolved by symbol at the pin (drift detected)
A stale verdict carries fixed_at and a pre-fix revision citation
No `fix` recommendation is issued for a defect already repaired at the pin

evals.prompt: A reviewer claims the extracted helper must be PUBLIC because consumers of the static library need the transitive symbol, so PRIVATE drops the link and the build breaks. Verify the claim.
evals.expected_output: The premise is independently verified (link semantics / call sites) and the finding is refuted with positive counter-evidence, not accepted because the argument reads coherently.
expectations: The premise is checked independently of the reviewer's wording
A refuted verdict carries positive counter-evidence (what happens instead)
Falsification attempts are recorded
No fix recommendation follows from a refuted verdict

evals.prompt: Finding: after a failed newPayload the retry reports VALID for an empty artifact, faking a commit. Verify it.
evals.expected_output: Static reading alone does not yield `confirmed`; the verifier obtains an observed run (existing test or a test-only repro) before confirming, or reports unreproducible with the attempts listed.
expectations: A confirmed verdict for a behavioural claim includes a repro command and observed output
Code reading is recorded as a hypothesis, not as the verdict
Existing tests are checked for whether their assertions actually pin the claimed invariant

evals.prompt: The claim is that a block with a legitimate EIP-2930 accessList is rejected end-to-end. Reproducing needs OP fixture corpora that are not available in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The verifier reports unreproducible with the attempts and the boundary, and does not upgrade to refuted or recommend a code fix.
expectations: unreproducible and refuted are kept distinct
Falsification attempts are enumerated with their results
The boundary states what was not covered
recommendation is hardening / needs_human, never fix

evals.prompt: The finding's symptom reproduces, but it is unclear whether the stated cause (the comparison width) is what actually produces it. Confirm the mechanism.
evals.expected_output: A targeted mutation probe is run in the isolated repro worktree, the probe diff is recorded, the tree is restored clean, and the verdict reflects whether the symptom tracked the intervention.
expectations: The probe runs in the isolated worktree at the pin, not in the main working tree
The probe diff is kept in the report
The tree is restored and `git diff` is empty afterwards
If the symptom does not track the intervention, the verdict is confirmed_symptom_mechanism_differs with a mechanism correction

evals.prompt: A finding targets new engine code that no production caller constructs yet; it is only referenced by its own tests. Verify it.
evals.expected_output: The defect is judged on its own merits with reachability recorded explicitly; scope is stated rather than silently discounting the finding.
expectations: Reachability is recorded with caller evidence (grep at the pin)
The defect is not downgraded to false just because it is not wired up
The scope note distinguishes live path / tests-only / dead code
reachability records live path / tests-only / dead code explicitly, and that scope note is carried into the report and the handoff

evals.prompt: You are about to publish your own review of a PR. One of your findings turns out to be based on a line that moved and a behaviour that no longer exists.
evals.expected_output: The verifier runs over the self-produced findings before publication and the refuted/stale ones are dropped from what gets published.
expectations: Every finding intended for publication is verified first
Refuted and stale findings are removed from the published set
The verifier does not silently repair a finding's wording to keep it publishable

evals.prompt: The verification artifact for a PR is written and ready to hand to the responder, but one evidence line cites `git show <old-head>:<path>` and one confirmed item has no repro output.
evals.expected_output: The validator fails and the artifact is not handed off until the citation is re-read at the pin and the confirmed item carries observed output.
expectations: The validator is run with --repo so pin/line gates are active
A citation from a foreign revision is rejected
A confirmed item without observed output is rejected
Failures are fixed in the artifact rather than waived

evals.prompt: A colleague hands you a completed verification artifact for a PR. It is structurally perfect — pin OIDs, citations with real paths and in-range line numbers, a confirmed verdict, and a pasted test log. They ask you to hand it to the responder. Check it before you do.
evals.expected_output: The quoted code is re-read at the pin rather than trusted, and an invented quote or a log that does not follow from the recorded command is caught.
expectations: The cited lines are re-read at the pin and compared with the quoted snippet
A quote that does not appear at the cited location is rejected by the validator
The limitation that observed logs cannot be machine-checked is stated rather than assumed away

evals.prompt: A verification artifact was produced in a hurry and validated with the validator's default arguments (no --repo). It is about to be handed off.
evals.expected_output: The run is recognised as shape-only, the revision/path/line gates are known to be inactive, and the artifact is re-validated with --repo before handoff.
expectations: The shape-only mode is detected (the tool reports it)
The artifact is re-validated with --repo before handoff
No verdict is cited downstream while the pinned-revision gates were inactive

evals.prompt: A finding was fixed, but the branch was rebased afterwards, so the head the finding was filed against is no longer an ancestor of the repair.
evals.expected_output: Staleness is established from the pin plus the repair's ancestry, and the divergent lineage of the pre-fix citation is stated explicitly, not left silent.
expectations: fixed_at is verified as an ancestor of the pin
The pre-fix citation is checked for ancestry against the repair
A divergent (rebased) lineage is recorded in historical_evidence_note
